frame.wallConvention: a wall runs from start to end along its OUTER face at its base; its outward normal is up x u, so exterior rings are traversed counter-clockwise on a plan drawn with the front facade at the bottom and material lies to the left of the direction of travel
frame.x: right when looking at the front facade
frame.z: away from the front facade, into the building
